name: W Doha Hotel & Residences
insider_take: Where bold Arabian luxury meets cutting-edge W attitude — the W Doha isn't just a hotel, it's a statement on the Doha skyline.
whats_special: Rising dramatically along the West Bay waterfront, the W Doha Hotel & Residences is an architectural showstopper that blends Qatar's rich cultural heritage with W Hotels' signature Whatever/Whenever® service philosophy. Its iconic wave-inspired facade is instantly recognizable across Doha's glittering skyline. The hotel sits steps from the Doha City Center Mall and is perfectly positioned between the business district and the cultural heart of the city, including the Museum of Islamic Art. With multiple award-winning dining concepts, a rooftop WET® deck pool, and the AWAY® Spa, this property delivers a full sensory experience that few hotels in the Gulf can match.
pro_tip: Request a West Bay-facing room for jaw-dropping views of the Arabian Gulf — sunrise from your floor-to-ceiling windows is an absolute must. As a Marriott Luminous property, be sure to leverage your Marriott Bonvoy points for room upgrades or dining credits to maximize every dirham of value.
pros: Prime West Bay location with stunning city and sea views
Contemporary W brand design with vibrant lifestyle atmosphere
Multiple dining venues and rooftop pool with panoramic views
Access to Marriott Luminous benefits and points program
cons: Modern lifestyle brand may not suit traditional luxury preferences
